thread:
sam_procurement: Quick check — where are we on lead times and allocation for the H100 reorder? We have 12 topoff units queued and 4 RMA replacements waiting for provisioning. Need options for EU vs US split and an ETA to share with product.
liam_vendor_accts: Hey Sam — I pushed this to CoreLogics earlier. Baseline: 5–7w for factory new H100s. We do have the option of a partial air shipment for up to 6 units (~10–12 days) at an additional freight premium (~+18%).
liam_vendor_accts: Pricing note: list price unchanged but expedited air incurs surcharge. Also need a 20% deposit for split/air shipments.
ingrid_logistics: If we do partial air to EU, customs HS code and invoice description matter. Last time they flagged "accelerators" vs "compute modules" and hit an additional duty hold. Please confirm HS: 8471.50.
maria_ops: We also need to reconcile serials for the 4 RMAs before commit. Can we get a manifest early so our depot can stage loaners? We can't leave customer tenants offline waiting on serial mapping.
liam_vendor_accts: Understood. I can request manifest from CoreLogics today. AWB for the tentative air batch will be provided once the ship order is confirmed.
chauncey_oncall: Quick reminder — any partial air that goes through FRA will trigger additional depot handling times for our EU refurb pool. Factor +48–72h for staging and burn-in.
liam_vendor_accts: Also flagged: CoreLogics offered temporary loaners from their EU depot (3 units) on a 21d loaner agreement to cover the RMAs while new units transit. No extra fee but requires sign-off on the loaner SLA.
sam_procurement: Loaners sound good as a contingency. What's the process for KYC/insurance? We can't accept loaners where serials are untracked.
liam_vendor_accts: They require a quick acceptance form + a credit hold (refundable) for loaners. I'll push for waiver on the credit hold and provide full serial manifest. Expect RMA manifest + loaner manifest by EOD PST.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-78921 for S/N 9843-XX; Status: awaiting manifest upload.
maria_ops: When you have the manifest, include fields: serial, model, DOA flag, current depot location, cust tenant id. We run an internal script to ingest: ```csv
serial,model,doa_flag,location,tenant
9843-XX,H100,false,NYC-DEPOT,prod-frontend
``` 
ingrid_logistics: On customs: if we ship as "RMA replacement/loaner" we can classify under temporary import (suspension of duties) but needs clear paperwork and ATA carnets in some regions. For EU intra-movement it's simpler, but outside EU will need bond.
liam_vendor_accts: Noted. I'll ask CoreLogics for temporary import docs for the loaners and confirm whether air AWB can be flagged as "temporary import." If not, we'll route via courier with appropriate bonded handling.
sam_procurement: Also need a price comparison: full order vs. partial air + loaners. Can you provide 3-line breakdown: unit price, freight (sea vs air), deposit/credit hold, and expected lead times?
liam_vendor_accts: Will do. Preliminary: unit USD 28,500 ea (net), sea freight: included in lead time (5–7w), air freight surcharge: +18% per unit, deposit for split: 20% (refundable on full delivery), loaner credit hold: typically 0–20% depending on vendor (pushing 0%).
chauncey_oncall: Ops caveat — if loaners arrive we need to schedule burn-in on our staging cluster. Block 24–36h per unit for firmware reconciliation. Call this out to the vendor so they don't send units with preinstalled OEM profiles conflicting with our bake.
maria_ops: Agree. Also we need a timeline for serial reconciliation with our inventory system; please include expected manifest format and S3 presigned URL for upload.
liam_vendor_accts: I'll request: (a) manifest CSV, (b) AWB numbers once ready, (c) expected ship dates for sea vs air options, (d) loaner SLA docs. ETA for info: EOD PST (today).
sam_procurement: If corelogics can only do sea for everything and no loaners, we need to consider alternate vendor (HyperLane). Can you check availability/price there as a backup?
liam_vendor_accts: Yes — I pinged HyperLane yesterday. They quoted 3–4w on H200 availability (lower perf) and 6–8w on H100 new due to queue. Price slightly higher (~+5% net). I'll get written quotes.
ingrid_logistics: One more customs nuance — for split shipments, ensure the commercial invoice references the full PO and that partial shipments include "remaining qty on order" to avoid mismatched declarations.
maria_ops: OK. Action items: Liam to share manifests & quotes; Ingrid to advise on customs paper for EU loaner flow; Chauncey to confirm staging windows. We'll approve partial air + loaners if vendor waives credit hold and provides presigned manifest/awb.
liam_vendor_accts: Copy — pushing now. If CoreLogics approves loaner waiver, I'll escalate for manager sign-off and share the manifest link here.
sam_procurement: Thanks. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
